mariadb-client.note: Se descargan automaticamente al ejecutar setup/bootstrap.sh

system_packages.note: Self-contained offline bundle: assets/system/ contains the FULL recursive dependency closure (Ubuntu 24.04 amd64) for nginx, mariadb-client, unixodbc, libgd3, libxml2, libxslt1.1, curl, git, wget, tar (excluding only base priority required/important packages present on any Ubuntu). Works on a minimal/air-gapped Ubuntu 24.04. bootstrap.sh installs assets/system/*.deb first so shared deps (perl, fonts, libs) are present before the DB/nginx installs. Ship the folder, not a git checkout (.deb are gitignored).
